body.html: Ruen Rim Nan is a small wooden resort set right on the Nan River, in Huai Ket Subdistrict of Taphan Hin District. What makes it stand out from other stays around Taphan Hin is its riverside setting — the resort is positioned with views of the Nan River, with riverside seating areas and a swimming pool built with a small ornamental waterfall. It's a wooden-house resort that leans into quiet and calm, well suited to travellers driving through Taphan Hin who want to stay somewhere with atmosphere rather than just a bedroom in town.

There are two main room types: wooden houses (with two king beds, good for groups or families) and building rooms (one king, or two single beds). Rooms come with air-con, a TV and the basics you'd expect at this level, and the place keeps things clean. Rates start at around ฿900 for a building room and rise for the wooden houses or over long weekends — a fair price for a riverside resort in Taphan Hin.

The swimming pool is another thing that makes this more interesting than the average local stay — there's a small waterfall at the poolside and a shady, fresh feel, nice for kids to splash about or for a sit-down in the evening. The resort sits in a quiet riverside neighbourhood; the Taphan Hin town centre, railway station and market are not far, a few minutes by car. There's free parking on site, so it works better for self-drivers than for anyone relying on public transport.
"A wooden resort right on the Nan River — nice atmosphere, quiet and private, with a pool to swim in. Rooms are clean and parking is easy. Good for a relaxed riverside stay."

To be straight about it, this is a small resort in a rural district, not a big hotel. The property is still fairly new and online reviews are thinner than the in-town hotels, so for some dates you'll need to ask the property directly about prices, as it isn't listed on every platform. The riverside location in Huai Ket means it isn't next to the market or a row of restaurants, so for a wider choice of dinner you'll want to drive into town. And because it's a wooden house by the water, in the rainy season or at dusk you may want mosquito repellent.

One more thing to know: this is a resort that's about atmosphere more than full hotel facilities. There's no gym or large in-house restaurant; the focus is clean rooms, the pool and the riverside view. If you'd rather be central in Phichit town with everything within walking distance, or right by Taphan Hin railway station, Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin may suit you better. But if you want a genuine riverside resort feel on the Nan River, this place delivers it in its own way.

Overall, Ruen Rim Nan is an appealing option for anyone who wants a riverside stay in Taphan Hin, which isn't easy to find around here. Its clear selling points are the wooden houses on the Nan River, the pool with its little waterfall, and the calm. The trade-offs are that it's a small resort, the riverside location is away from the market, and reviews are still thin. If you're driving through the Taphan Hin area and want to stay somewhere with atmosphere rather than a plain town room, this wooden resort is well worth considering.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Ruen Rim Nan Resort Phichit

faq.q: Where is Ruen Rim Nan Resort, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Ruen Rim Nan sits at 48 Rim Nan Road, Huai Ket Subdistrict, Taphan Hin District, Phichit 66110, right on the Nan River. It's about 5-10 minutes by car from Taphan Hin town centre and the market, and roughly 10 minutes from Taphan Hin railway station. Phichit town centre is about 30-40 minutes away by car. Driving in yourself is the easiest way to get there.

faq.q: How much does Ruen Rim Nan Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿900/night for a building room. You can choose between building rooms (king, or two singles) and riverside wooden houses (two king beds, good for groups), which cost more. The resort isn't on every platform, so it's best to call the property directly to confirm prices and availability.

faq.q: Does Ruen Rim Nan Resort have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — there's a swimming pool with a small ornamental waterfall at the poolside, shady and fresh, nice for kids to swim or for an evening by the water. It's one of the things that sets this resort apart from the average stay in Taphan Hin, so pack your swimwear.

faq.q: What's the atmosphere like at Ruen Rim Nan Resort, and who is it for?
faq.a: It's a wooden resort right on the Nan River, with a quiet and private feel, riverside seating and a pool. It suits travellers driving through the Taphan Hin area who want an atmospheric riverside stay, whether as a couple or a family, more than anyone who needs a central base within walking distance of the market.

faq.q: Does Ruen Rim Nan Resort have parking?
faq.a: Yes — there's free parking on site. Because it's on the river in Huai Ket, away from the market and most restaurants, driving in yourself is the most convenient option; allow time to drive into town for dinner.

faq.q: Is there anything to prepare before staying at Ruen Rim Nan Resort?
faq.a: Because it's a wooden house by the water, there can be mosquitoes at dusk or in the rainy season, so bring repellent. And since the resort isn't on every platform, call the property (099-272-2999) or message its page to confirm prices and availability before you travel.
